`fopen("compress.bzip2://out.bz2", "w")` opened the underlying file and then
wrote PLAIN bytes through it. The handle looked like it worked — the write
succeeded, the byte count was right — and produced a file no bzip2 reader
accepts. The wrapper carried an explicit guard that downgraded a write open to
the read direction, which kept the lie consistent instead of surfacing it.
